question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2504f9f9a5d5fdda935602f05a3a4de3b681543e207924eae650cc85ed31464b.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

The total marks will be , 70 + 60 + 40 + 50 + 80 = 300

The average marks will be 300 / 5 = 60
